001package org.openstreetmap.josm.plugins.websitewizard;
002
003import org.openstreetmap.josm.gui.MapFrame;
004import org.openstreetmap.josm.gui.MapFrameListener;
005import org.openstreetmap.josm.plugins.Plugin;
006import org.openstreetmap.josm.plugins.PluginInformation;
007
008/**
009 * Main entry point for the JOSM Website Wizard Plugin.
010 * 
011 * To see changes in JOSM:
012 * 1. Save everything and run `ant dist` (`ant clean` probably only helpful before a release. Causes much longer build.)
013 * 2. Copy/Paste from ~/git/josm/josm/dist/websitewizard.jar to ~/Library/JOSM/plugins
014 * 3. Restart JOSM
015 * 
016 * Docs: https://josm.openstreetmap.de/doc/index.html
017 */
018public class WebsiteWizardPlugin extends Plugin implements MapFrameListener {
019
020    public WebsiteWizardPlugin(PluginInformation info) {
021        super(info);
022    }
023
024    @Override
025    public void mapFrameInitialized(MapFrame oldFrame, MapFrame newFrame) {
026        if (newFrame != null) {
027            newFrame.addToggleDialog(new WebsiteWizardDialog());
028        }
029    }
030}
